readme:
# mcp-forge

Build production-ready MCP servers in minutes, not days.

## Why mcp-forge?

- Decorator-based tool definitions
- Automatic JSON-schema generation
- Built-in stdio and streamable-http transports
- Testing utilities included

## Quickstart

```bash
npm install mcp-forge
```

Create your first server:

```ts
import { Forge } from "mcp-forge";

const app = new Forge("my-server");

app.tool("greet", { name: "string" }, async ({ name }) => {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
});

app.listen();
```

## Documentation

Full docs at https://mcp-forge.example.dev — guides for tools, resources, prompts, auth, deployment.

## Ecosystem

Hundreds of community servers are built on mcp-forge. Check the showcase for examples.
